rig.sides: anatomical; left is on viewer's right in the rest pose
rig.coordinates: integer pixels in the shared 768x640 canvas
rig.composition: source-over by ascending z, place every layer at (0,0) in rest pose
rig.pivotApplication: rotate around each pivot in rest canvas coordinates; propagate parent transforms down the tree

atlas.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a drawing atlas of separate animation pieces of reference image 1, this exact chibi game monster. Image 2 is the map background reference for contrast and hue context ONLY, draw no scenery. Each piece in its own strictly regular invisible 3 columns by 2 rows cell. Paint independent whole components and short hidden overlap stubs at joints. Use strong ink outlines, opaque cel shading, detailed saturated fantasy game shapes, slightly elevated front three-quarter orthographic. Generous transparent margins between every piece, no floor, border, shadow or labels. Genuine transparent backdrop. Organize body parts exactly in the following reading order:
1. golem head only: dark gray basalt wedge head, stern amber glowing eyes and fire cracks.
2. large hunch-backed torso with big bright diamond amber molten core, basalt chunks with thick warm orange seams, no limbs.
3. left long arm with oversized dark basalt fist, burnt-orange seams; angled down-right.
4. right long arm with oversized dark basalt fist, orange seams; angled down-left.
5. left wide squat segmented basalt leg and broad foot.
6. right wide squat segmented basalt leg and broad foot.
